==Description==
'''Fave''' was an [[Emotes|emote]] that could have been bought in the store for {{Coins|500}}. It was made by [https://www.roblox.com/users/16983447/profile BelowNatural]. The emote was looped and music could be heard while performing the emote. You could move while performing this emote.

==Trivia==
*This [[Emotes|emote]] was based on the pose the Roblox YouTuber [https://www.youtube.com/user/ROBLOXFave Fave] used to do at the end of [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vYLBYkNHlm0 his videos].
**The music that played while performing this video is a remixed version of the [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iuYMBsxU2XI Customization 1] music from ''Saints Row: The Third'', as that music played in Fave's outro, although not remixed.
*The [[Emotes|emote]] was removed as people would use this emote (which looked like a K) to spell out the acronym for the [[wp:Ku Klux Klan|Ku Klux Klan]], a white supremacist far-right hate group, if stood in a line.
**This was against Roblox Terms of Service, and so the emote was removed from the game to avoid controversy.
**There were actually preventive measures against this happening in-game, as being the third person in close proximity (most often a line) of other people performing it would cause you and anyone who tried to join you to get struck and killed by lightning. This however was not good enough and the emote would be removed regardless of that.<ref>[[File:FaveLightningProof.png|280px]]</ref>
**This was one of the quickest removals of content in the game, being deleted around 4 hours after being released.
*Anyone who bought this emote was not refunded {{Coins|500}}.
